office_does: The county auditor runs Asotin County's elections, records deeds and other documents and keeps the county's accounts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Darla McKay, in office since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Asotin County Auditor since 2011 and a former Washington State Election Administrator, running unopposed for another term.
highlights: Auditor since 2011; Washington State Election Administrator, 2021-2022 [S1]
Added ballot drop boxes, longer office hours and a property recording alert service [S1]
